logline: A freelance filmmaker discovers her camera records future events, including a warning from her future self about an impending disaster and a mysterious betrayal, forcing her to make a critical choice to alter her fate.

scenes_scheduled.heading: INT. MAYA'S APARTMENT - NIGHT
scenes_scheduled.summary: Maya works on monitors when her old digital camera mysteriously turns on, showing a future timestamp. She discovers a video file from her future self.
vfx_requirements: Camera screen displaying future timestamp and filenames
Camera screen displaying video file list
scenes_scheduled.notes: Establish Maya's solitary world. Focus on camera as unsettling element. Capture clean plates for VFX.

scenes_scheduled.heading: ON THE LAPTOP SCREEN - VIDEO
scenes_scheduled.summary: A video plays showing Future Maya in a damaged apartment, warning current Maya about an upcoming event, the 11:47 train, and not to trust Daniel.
vfx_requirements: Laptop screen video playback (screen replacement) of Future Maya in a damaged apartment
scenes_scheduled.notes: Convey urgent information through recorded message. Coordinate VFX playback with actor performance. Capture clean plates for screen replacement.

scenes_scheduled.heading: INT. MAYA'S APARTMENT - LATER
scenes_scheduled.summary: Maya receives a text and call from Daniel, who also saw a future video and urges her to destroy the camera. The apartment lights flicker, and the camera begins recording again.
scenes_scheduled.notes: Show immediate consequences and Daniel's connection. Emphasize unsettling supernatural elements. Coordinate practical effects (flickering lights) with VFX.

production_notes: Plan for extensive neighbor outreach and obtain written permissions for night shoot.
Utilize silent generators and sound blankets to minimize noise during night filming.
Careful lighting control to avoid light spill into neighboring residences.
Coordinate VFX playback for camera screen displays (future timestamp, filenames) and laptop screen (Future Maya video).
Capture clean plates and reference footage for all VFX shots.
Manage equipment footprint to minimize disruption in the residential setting.
safety_and_logistics: Secure a formal location release from apartment owner/management.
Confirm local film permit requirements with city/county film office for residential filming.
Ensure Certificate of Insurance names property owner/management as additional insured.
Manage all cables and equipment to prevent trip hazards within the apartment and common areas.
Thorough neighbor notification with detailed filming schedules and contact information.

scenes_scheduled.heading: INT. TRAIN STATION - NIGHT
scenes_scheduled.summary: At the train station, Maya's camera records a figure behind her and a train derailing. Daniel, on the arriving train, urges her to get off. She does, and the timeline updates.
vfx_requirements: Camera screen displaying recorded footage of a figure appearing behind Maya (screen replacement)
Camera screen displaying stylized train derailing (screen replacement)
scenes_scheduled.notes: Build tension and urgency in a public, chaotic space. Focus on critical decision and timeline alteration via camera display. Coordinate VFX playback with actor performance. Capture clean plates for all VFX shots.

production_notes: Strategic shot blocking and framing to avoid capturing identifiable members of the public without consent; consider paid extras if necessary.
Coordinate VFX playback for camera screen displays (figure behind Maya, stylized train derailing, 'TIMELINE UPDATED.').
Capture clean plates and reference footage for all VFX shots.
Review costume design for Maya and Daniel to avoid prohibited colors (red, yellow, green) that interfere with railway signals.
Plan for efficient movement of compact, battery-operated equipment due to station restrictions.
Develop clear contingency plans for potential disruptions from active train schedules or public interference.
safety_and_logistics: Initiate permit application process immediately with relevant railway operator and local film commission. Be prepared for extensive documentation and lead times.
Secure Public Liability Certificate of Insurance with substantial coverage (e.g., no less than $20M AUD) naming the railway authority as an additional insured.
Mandate Railroad Safety Training for all crew members working near tracks or platforms. A dedicated safety officer is required on set.
Strictly adhere to all railway operator instructions, including equipment restrictions (e.g., battery-only power, lighting limitations), and operational protocols.
Confirm filming hours and specific night-time protocols with the selected station operator to avoid peak operational hours and comply with restrictions.
Manage all cables and equipment to prevent trip hazards on platforms and public access areas.
Avoid activity that disrupts staff, passengers, or train operations. Be aware of moving equipment at all times.
Drones are generally not permitted; confirm with railway operator if any aerial shots are considered.
